CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 10, 2024

1  chairperson simison called the meeting of the La verne planning
  Commission to order at 6:31 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Duffy led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3  ROLL GALL: Planning commissioners present: Jason simison, Thomas
  Allison, Keny chang, and Erin Duffy.Advisory personnel present: principal
  Planner Candice Bowcock and Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow.
  Absent: Commissioner Jeremy Conrad.

4.  MINUTES - March 13,2024

  It was moved by commissioner DuO and seconded by commissioner
  Allison to approve the minutes of the March 13, zo24 meeting. Motion
  carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6  CASE NO. 22.24CUP - 2232 D STREET, SUITE 203 - CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT FOR RUMA YOGA STUDTO

  RESOLUTION NO. 1324

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF LA
  VERNE, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING CASE NO. 22.24CUP TO ALLOW
  THE OPERATION OF A YOGA STUDIO AT 2232 D STREET, AND
  AFFIRMING A CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALIW ACT.

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented the staff report for Planning
  lntern valerie chin. The applicant, Tyrone Rudulph was present at the
  meeting.
 Planning Commission Minutes - April 10,2024

  The Commissioners stated they are all looking fonvard to the new business
  in La Verne and welcomed them.

  chairperson Simison opened publlc comment. There were no comments.
  Chairperson Simison closed public comment.

  It was moved by commissioner Allison and seconded by commissioner
  Chang to approve Resolution No. 1324. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

PLANNING COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS

  commissioner Allison wanted to make a statement that he is happy with the
  increase of new health and wellness businesses opening in the city.
  commissioner chang stated he was glad more small businesses are
  coming to our city.

DIRECTOR COMMENTS

  Ms. Bowcock stated that no items are being tracked for the May planning
  Commission meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:44 p.m. The next regular meeting of the
  Planning Commission will be held May 8, 2024 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council
  Chambers, 3660 "D" Street,  9'1750.
